headline: Musk Accelerates Optimus Mass Production; Yangtze River Delta Suppliers Begin Accepting Tesla's "Mass Production Health Check"
summary: Tesla is reportedly running a new round of humanoid robot supply chain audits in China's Yangtze River Delta. Several component suppliers have received Optimus-related orders.
why: Tesla is a US electric vehicle and energy company developing its Optimus humanoid robot, and its suppliers in China are a key part of that production chain.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Tesla is auditing suppliers and placing Optimus orders with component companies in the Yangtze River Delta.
